# Overview

[🔗 **View the full GitHub repository**](https://github.com/jessicaxiaoo/Star-Charge-Log-Analysis)

This project analyzes **300K+ EV charging log records** to uncover usage patterns, charging-step behavior, and potential anomalies.  
I built reusable Python pipelines to automate cleaning, aggregation, and visualization, reducing engineering analysis time and improving interpretability.
